name: WDSEventDB
description: Water distribution networks (WDS) are critical infrastructures whose security against stress and failures is vital to societal well-being and socio-economic development. Recent technological advances in sensor technologies have enabled the collection of real-time hydraulic datasets. These datasets can be leveraged to develop data-driven models for real-time event detection in WDS. However, most existing datasets remain proprietary and inaccessible to the public.
